title: Sidebar configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.SidebarAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

Direction.description: Side of the screen the sidebar opens from (left or right).

HasOverlay.description: Dims the page behind the sidebar with an overlay while it is open (and closes on click outside).

StartsOpen.description: Renders the sidebar open when it is built.

Width.description: Width of the sidebar (CSS length); 500px by default.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
